name: Tiki Joe's at Captree Boat Basin
address: 3500 Ocean Pkwy (Captree Boat Basin, Captree State Park)

evidence.note: Official page: concession and Captain's Table restaurant at the boat basin, with a music schedule link.
Review mentions a band setting up on a Sunday afternoon; no mention of dancing.

dancing.notes: Bands play here on weekend afternoons by the boat basin, but we found no reports about dancing. It is mostly a casual place to eat and drink by the water.

description: A waterfront seafood restaurant and snack concession at the Captree State Park boat basin, with indoor and outdoor seating, bay views and weekend bands.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Tiki Joe's has more than one location (for example at Cedar Beach); Ira specified Captree. Postal city/ZIP varies by listing (Babylon 11702, Bay Shore 11706, or 11757), so ZIP is left out. It is inside Captree State Park, where a state parking fee may apply. Mach 5 on Oct 4 not checked on the music schedule page. Ira's List has a /tiki-joes-venues page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Mach 5 Band on Sun Oct 4 is confirmed on the venue's music schedule (5:30-8:30 PM). Google gives the postal address as 3500 Ocean Pkwy, Bay Shore, NY 11706, so we used ZIP 11706 (other listings use Babylon 11702). The email is the operator's (Top Flight Hospitality / JB Restaurants), shown in the page footer. No opening hours are published (concession 'open daily'; music 5:30-8:30 PM, weather permitting). The Tiki Joe's site uses a travel theme that still shows placeholder text (a Miami address and fake phone numbers) and stock photos (sailboat, beach); we ignored those. Several venue photos carry a 'JoVon Photography' watermark, so only one un-watermarked photo was kept.
